Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 sponsorship on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas
free General Admission access for the Cardano community
complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects

request.what: Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream plus title sponsorship/support for Rare Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, stated as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages for Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.

The proposal allocates ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 sponsorship, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network says it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current VIP ticket retail value stated as $900.
Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but the requested funding would expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and strategic industry outreach.
Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The proposal reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 annual attendance, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social impressions, 40+ Cardano projects represented, and 50+ enterprise participants.

The proposal states that the first Cardano Dev Gov Day in 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included workshops, panels, networking, a Charles Hoskinson keynote, and governance and technical education.
The proposal includes external supporting links to videos, a Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 report, a recap, and a livestream post for prior event activity.

Selected Cardano projects and individuals would apply through open forms for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, and travel or lodging assistance, with selection prioritizing ecosystem contribution and in-person value creation.

The proposal says sponsorship benefits may change if mainstage or livestream inventory is sold before approval, in which case Cardano would receive a sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value such as Enterprise & Policy Social, Registration, Closeout Party, or College Row.

summary: The document requests ₳2.75M for Rare Network to provide Cardano title sponsorship and related event benefits around Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, citing prior event history, attendance and media metrics, accessibility benefits, and a planned 20% VIP ticket sales return to the treasury.
